paragraphs.name: Situation
paragraphs.plain: What is wrong with dictation and why: the recognizer has no vocabulary.

strand.last: Diagnosed 9/3 after the mic check: not the mic.
strand.plan: Two levers, three routes, one ruling.
strand.you: You asked whether a voice library could stop the misunderstandings. This is that BOLO.

items.t: **Not the mic.** Common words land clean; proper nouns and numbers garble (Ultrasin → ultrasound · Blender → blamer · SOP → SLP · how copy → hau copy · BOLO → below, buffalo, boat). A recognizer with no vocabulary guesses the nearest real word.

**Whisper has no dictionary.** Two levers: the **initial prompt** (text the model reads before every utterance, biasing spellings toward the Command lexicon) and **post-transcription replacement** (a find/replace over the transcript). Every "custom dictionary" feature in any Whisper front-end is one or both. A fine-tune is the third lever and unnecessary.
**The replacement table already exists:** the SOP §8 dictation codebook, 35 rows and growing one per catch, parsed live onto the [[soi|SOI]] page.

Years as "twenty oh five". Critical proper nouns slightly slower, once; spell a new name the first time. Boom mic a few inches off at a fixed distance; input 70 to 80 percent; audio enhancements off if the tool fights them.

paragraphs.intent: in order to make every spoken order land clean and stop the garble table growing.

endstate: A push-to-talk tool on the box that types clean Command vocabulary into any window.
The lexicon prompt and the replacement table are generated from SOP §0 and §8, never hand-kept.
The garble table stops growing except for new coinages.

phases.t: **BUILD:** hotkey → record → faster-whisper (CTranslate2, the GPU) with the lexicon prompt → §8 replacements → type into the focused window. One evening.
**INSTALL:** verify whisper-writer (savbell) and Whispering (epicenter) for Windows, initial prompt, replacements; configure with the lexicon and the codebook.
**Either way:** generate the prompt from SOP §0 and the table from §8 by script, so the SOP stays the single source.
